drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 71-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.55, creatinine 0.77, hemoglobin 12.9, pao2 56, platelets 284, sodium 140, wbc 8.2; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 82-87, map 91-96, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-32, sbp 122-127, spo2 88-94, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute respiratory failure with hypoxia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.83, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 283, sodium 140, wbc 8.3; vitals dbp 76-82, heart_rate 83-87, map 92-97, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 22-26, sbp 124-130, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute respiratory failure with hypoxia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 71-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute respiratory failure with hypoxia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
